body: Yellow grains crust the jar's rim and spill from the torn seed sack tied to it. The sack's label names a test plot. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: A jar beyond the rows at closing

body: A clean bottle and a cloudy bucket share a chalk mark. The bucket was filled far from the rows after the sprayer passed. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: Water kept for comparison at closing

body: One cuff holds field dust; the other is stained with kitchen soap. The empty sprayer was carried past a household door. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: The gloves used twice at closing

body: The feed sack has an oily streak beneath its fold. A rinse pail carries the same oily mark above the waterline, with a few yellow grains floating in it. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.
title: Feed beside a rinse pail at closing

body: Tape seals a slit in the seed sack, but the pale treated-seed dust has caught on the outside of the tape. A child's height is marked on it. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.
title: The unopened seed allotment at closing

body: The jar's paper label names a trial row, and the residue inside matches a plot marked on the map. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: A sample without its field at closing

body: The loaf was wrapped in clean cloth, the knot never opened. A strip of barrier tape lies across the knot with a numbered tag beneath it. Someone retied the string after the morning patrol cleared the block.
title: Bread under tape at closing

body: The sponge is dry and the soap is worn only on one edge. They were wrapped in a bag sealed with barrier tape beside a small cup, with a numbered tag tied to the bag. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: The wash set sealed at closing

body: The card asks for supper to be kept warm. A ring from the sprayer crosses the writing before the ink has dried. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: A warning carried home at closing

body: A drinking glass and canvas bag bound together with barrier tape, marked with an evacuation tag bearing a thumbprint and partial official stamp. The seal remains intact—these items were logged and processed according to procedure, but the checkpoint itself was abandoned before anyone returned to collect them.
title: Belongings sealed at abandoned checkpoint
